title: Legion of Super-Heroes #266 DC 1980 Bouncing Boy Duo Damsel Return Newsstand
condition_description: Bright cover with light handling wear and light wear at the edges. Small handwritten "C-375" by the barcode. See photos.
description:
Legion of Super-Heroes #266 (August 1980), DC Comics - "The Thing in the Jar!" The return of Bouncing Boy and Duo Damsel, with Wildfire. Dick Giordano cover. Newsstand edition (barcode), 40 cent cover price.

Condition: bright with light handling wear and light edge wear. Small handwritten "C-375" beside the barcode (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
